Hwɛ mfa ntafo fã no ne wo ne obi bom. Wo nsusuwii sɛ ɔkyɛn biara yɛ nea ɛde ne ho?
Di fã wɔ nifa so, afei di nea ɛfa nifa so a ɛfa ho. Ɛbɛyɛ adwuma nso sɛ wosan yɛ saa.
Fã a ɛfa ho bom no wɔ abɔ kɛse ne aboa. Fã a ɛnfa ho no kyɛ bio, na wubetumi ahwehwɛ foforɔ.
Di "Ma me hu" sɛnea wopɛ, afei di "Nhyehyɛe foforɔ" ma mfonini foforɔ.
tips: Fa wo nsa tu so ɛkɔ fã no anim. Wɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnne no kɔ mfimfini?
Ka nea wuhu kyerɛ: "Ɛno wɔ kɛtɛɛ." Ɛnhia sɛ wotwe mfonini biara din.
Sɛ wobɛtwa ankasa a ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wobɛtwe ntɛm. Fa mo ho mu ntem wɔ ahyɛnsode no so na mo mu biara nhu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ ɔberɛsɛm anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni dwumadi, nsɛnkyerɛnne, ntentan kuruwa anaa ɔhwehwɛ. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wugyae ne ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛfata sɛ wubegyae.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛba sɛ fã abien nfa ho?
faq.a: Biribiara a ɛbɛyɛ wo haw nni hɔ. Ɛnni nsɔsɛm, ɛnni ɔkɔkɔɔ ntaban anaa ahoɔfɛ. Fã abien no kyɛ bio, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no ka sɛ, "Saa mmienu yi nfa ho. Hwehwɛ foforɔ." Wɔnkan biribiara.

faq.q: Mfonini no yɛ mmerɛ sɛ wobɛka wɔn ho ayɛ?
faq.a: Aane. Wɔpaw mfonini no de nsa, na ɛnyɛ mfonini abien a efi nkyekyɛmu baako mu wɔ sɛdeɛ kanea biara, sɛnea aba abien anaa mmoa abien. Mfonini a wɔn fã abien hwɛ sɛ ɛte pɛpɛɛpɛ, sɛnea osian anaa ɔpɔtweaa, no wɔyi firi mu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ krataa so nhyehyɛe ana?
faq.a: Ee. Ɔpeɛ a wɔde ahyɛ mu, hɔ de mfonini abien ɛwɔ no ɛnyinam mfã a ɛwɔ baguan mu ne ɛnyinam mfã a ɛwɔ nifa mu, nanso wɔahyehyɛ mu foforo. Fa ahyɛ ɛnyinam mfã biara ne ɛfata ne ho no ntam.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ bebree a na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ bebree, na ɛnhia akaunt, kyerɛw din anaa ɛfiri Intanɛt ase. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔbrowsa a ɛwɔ fon, tablet anaa kɔmputa so.

color-by-number.name: Color by number
color-by-number.seoTitle: Color by Number: a Calm Large-Print Fill Game
color-by-number.h1: Color by Number: Fill the Squares, Any Color You Like
color-by-number.description: A grid of large numbered squares and a key of four colors with their names. Choose a color, then tap squares to fill them. Any color is fine, there is no timer or score, and a button fills the rest by the numbers. Free to play and print.
color-by-number.short: Choose a color, then tap the numbered squares to fill them.
color-by-number.intro: A square grid of large squares, each with a number, and a key above it with four colors, each with its number and its written name. Choose a color from the key, then tap squares to fill them. The grid is 4 by 4 to start, with 6 by 6 and 8 by 8 when you want more squares. When every square has the color of its number, the grid is the picture on the sheet. Squares filled with any other color are simply your own picture, and the game says nothing about it. "Fill with the numbers" fills every empty square for you.
howTo: Choose the grid size. 4 by 4 has the biggest squares and is the simplest.
Look at the key above the grid. Each color has a number and a name, such as 1 Yellow.
Tap a color in the key, then tap the squares you would like to fill with it.
Use the color on the number, or any color you like. Both are fine.
Tap "Fill with the numbers" for the empty squares, "Clear" to start the grid again, or "Another picture" for a different one.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person chooses the color, the other taps the square.
Talk about the colors: "I like the green." There is no need to name what the picture will be.
On a narrow screen the 8 by 8 grid scrolls sideways inside its own box. The squares stay a comfortable size.
The paper version works as well with pencils at a bedside table.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What if I use a different color from the number?
faq.a: Nothing happens, and that is the point. Any color can go in any square, and the game says nothing about it. When every square has the color of its number the game says so gently, and a picture in your own colors is just as good.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a number, a written name and its own small shape, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four fills were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness, and they also differ in lightness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 48 pixels across, and 56 on the 4 by 4 grid. If a grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has a numbered grid and the key of four colors with their names. Color each square with a pencil of the color on its number, or any color you like.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

pattern-maker.name: Pattern maker
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern Maker: Design a Tile and Print the Pattern
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern Maker: Design a Tile, See It Repeat
pattern-maker.description: Change the squares of one small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern beside it, in four colors that each have a name and a shape. No timer or score. Free to play and print.
pattern-maker.short: Change the squares of a small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern.
pattern-maker.intro: A small tile of 3 by 3 squares, or 4 by 4 if you like, and beside it "your pattern": the same tile repeated in a block. Tap a square and it changes to the next of four colors, each with its own written name and shape. The pattern beside it changes at once. There is no right pattern and nothing is saved or sent. "Print my pattern" puts the repeated pattern on one page to keep, color in or give away.
howTo: Look at the tile and at your pattern beside it. They are the same tile, repeated.
Tap a square. It changes to the next color in the row of four colors above.
Keep tapping squares until the pattern looks the way you would like. Any pattern is a good one.
Tap "Surprise me" for a new tile, or "Start again" for a clear one. "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.
Tap "Print my pattern" if you would like it on paper, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Ka wo ho ano ka ho: "Ɛte sɛ ɔdua." Ɛho hia sɛ wobɔ ade din biara.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything I make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Your tile stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep a pattern, print it.

faq.q: What if I tap the wrong square or clear the tile by accident?
faq.a: There is no wrong square: tap it again to move on to the next color. After "Start again" or "Surprise me", "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print my pattern" prints the pattern you made on one page, with the four colors and their names, fine in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

drawing-duet.name: Mfonini Duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Mfonini Duet: Nnipa Baanu, Mfonini Baako
drawing-duet.h1: Mfonini Duet: Nnipa Baanu, Krataa Baako
drawing-duet.description: Nnipa baanu bɛsi kɔlɔ ankasa so, obiara de ne kɔlɔ, wɔ kanvas baako so. Obiara nnya mmuaeɛ na obiara nnya nkonim. Wobetumi asie mfonini no anaa akɔ no krataa mu. Ɛnhwehwɛ sika, na ɛnhia akaunt.
drawing-duet.short: Ka wo nkyɛn nipa bi, monsi mfonini baako so bere a obiara ka nea ɔpɛ.
drawing-duet.intro: Kanvas baako, nnipa baanu. Mo mu obiara paw ne kɔlɔ, na kɔlɔ biara wɔ ne din a wɔakyerɛw so. Monsi bere: obiara de tia baako anaa ntoma kɔ so, afei ɔfoforo nso. Obiara betumi agyae bere biara. Mfonini no nni nea ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ, na mmuaeɛ nni hɔ. Sɛ wopɛ mfonini no a, wobetumi asie no wɔ wo adeɛ so, anaa wobetumi akɔ krataa mu: krataa baako, ntoma abien.
howTo: Obiara paw ne kɔlɔ. Banner no kyerɛ nea ɛyɛ ne bere, ne kɔlɔ din nso ka ho.
Fa nsa, mouse anaa ntoma tia baako anaa ntoma kɔ so. Anaa fa keyboard so mpɔn ne Space de tia nkɔ so a wonnyɛ pointer.
Sɛ wo ho yɛ wo a, mia "Fa ntoma no kɔ". Obiara betumi ayɛ saa bere biara.
Mia "Gyae me tia a ɛdi awiei" de yi tia a ɛdi awiei a ɔno a ɛyɛ ne bere no ahyɛ.
Mia "Sie mfonini" de sie mfonini wɔ saa device yi so, anaa "Kɔ krataa mu" de nya krataa baako ne ntoma abien.
tips: Monnyin mu mo ho na mo ka nkɔ so bere a moreka: "Mede ɔsɛnsɛn bɛka aba kɔnkɔn."
Fi ase ne ɔbɔnsɛm baako, tia baako anaa ntoma a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, na ma ɔfoforo nso nkyɛrɛ.
Obiara nhia sɛ ɔtwa nea ɛyɛ biribi. Nsɛm a ɛyɛ tia nso ye sɛ ɔhwɛ bere.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woregyae a, mia "Mafi ase ɛnnɛ". Mfonini no ntena hɔ wo ansa na woarefi nkɔ so a, sɛ woansie no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ obi a ɔdi nkonim anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni obi a ɔdi nkonim, nkontaabu, bere a wɔde susu, anaa bere a wɔkan sɛ nnipa abien ayɛ. Ɛnni mfonini a ɛyɛ nea ɛsɛ, na wɔnnhyɛ biribi ano anaa wɔnnhwɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw.

faq.q: Wɔsie mfonini no anaa wɔsoma no?
faq.a: Dabi, biribiara nnkɔ baabi. Mfonini no tena saa nkyɛn yi so kosi sɛ wobɛtwa ho. Sɛ wodi Sie mfonini a, wɔbɛyɛ krataa wɔ wo device so ama woakyere. Obiara nnfa so.

faq.q: Metumi agyae tia bi?
faq.a: Dabi. "Gyae me tia a ɛdi awiei" yi tia a ɛdi awiei a ɔno a ɛyɛ ne bere no ahyɛ. "Fi ase bio" pono no nyinaa, na "Sane fa so" de tia no san aba, baako nko.

faq.q: Metumi de a mmɔ mouse anaa touch screen nyɛ no?
faq.a: Dabi. Bere a mfonini no ka ho no, keyboard so mpɔn ne ntoma nkɔ so, na Space ma ntoma no bɔ ase anaa ɔfi ase. Ɔpon kyerɛ "Ntoma abɔ ase" anaa "Ntoma afi ase" bere biara.

faq.q: Kɔlɔ nkɔ dɛn, na nnipa a wɔnhunu kɔlɔ yie betumi ahu wɔn ho?
faq.a: Akɔkɔɔdɔ, ahoma, ahabammono ne aduru, nea ɛyɛ kɔlɔ nnan a yɛde di dwuma wɔ yɛn afoforo mfonini akyinnyegye mu. Kɔlɔ biara wɔ din a wɔakyerɛw, na din no ka tia no ho. Yɛahwɛ kɔlɔ no wɔ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛda adi sɛ nnipa ahunu kɔlɔ ahorow nsɛnnennen, nanso obi a ahunu kɔlɔ nsɛnnennen nnyaa so hwɛ.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ krataa mu nhyehyɛe?
faq.a: Dabi. "Kɔ krataa mu" de krataa baako ne mmara a wɔatwerɛ so ne krataa kɛse a ɛnni biribiara wɔ so kɔ, ama nnipa baanu de ntoma abien. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tintin ne fitaa nkyɛn.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ akwaaba anaa ɛhia sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛyɛ akwaaba, na ɛnhia akaunt, ankyerɛwdin anaa sɛ wobɛtwe biribi. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

build-together.name: Build together
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Two People Build One Pattern
build-together.h1: Build Together: Two People, One Grid
build-together.description: Two people take turns to put a piece in a shared grid until it is full, each with a color of their own that has a name and a shape. Nobody wins, and there is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
build-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to fill one shared grid.
build-together.intro: A shared grid of 4 by 4 places, or 3 by 3 if you like. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name and shape. You take turns: on your turn, tap an empty place to put your piece there. When every place has a piece, the picture is built together. There is no winner, because you make it as a pair, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print the grid" puts an empty grid on one page so you can build with two pencils.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. A color the other person has is marked "In use".
The first person goes first. The screen says whose turn it is and which color is theirs.
Tap an empty place to put your piece there. The turn passes to the other person.
If you would rather not place a piece, tap "Pass". Either of you may pass at any time.
When every place has a piece, you have built the picture together. Tap "Start again" to build another, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side so you can both see and reach the screen. Talk as you go: "I will put mine next to yours."
Try to build a pattern, stripes, a checkerboard or a border, or just place pieces anywhere you like. Both are fine.
A child or a person who tires easily can pass as often as they like. The picture is still built together.
On paper, each person uses one pencil and draws their own shape in the empty squares.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, because you build one picture together. There is no clock, score, count of pieces or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The grid stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep it, print the grid and build on paper.

faq.q: What if I put a piece in the wrong place?
faq.a: There is no wrong place. Tap "Take back the last piece" and the turn goes back to you. You can take back one step at a time, and a pass can be taken back too.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each piece, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every place is at least 56 pixels across. If the grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the places.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Aane. "Prin grid no" prints grid a ɛnni biribiara mu wɔ axɛ baako so, ne ɔhɔho mmienu ne wɔn din, na ɛma mo mfa peŋsel mmienu ahyɛ so. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tuntum ne fitaa mu, efisɛ ɔhɔho biara wɔ ne sɛdeɛ ankasa.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din ansa?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din ahyɛ mu anaa nkɔsoɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ fon, tablet anaa komputa so.

seated-toss.name: Tebel so ntwa tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Tebel so Ntwa Tally: Bean-Bag Akyɛde Ma Nnipa 2
seated-toss.h1: Tebel so Ntwa Tally: Monntɔ Bom Wɔ Tebel Ho
seated-toss.description: Nnipa mmienu wɔ tebel ho tɔ bean bag a ɛyɛ nwini kɔ target kɛse mu, na wɔde tally kɔ paper so. Biribiara nnyina bere anaa nkontaabu. Ɛyɛ ahofadi sɛ wobɛprin.
seated-toss.short: Monwa mu tɔ bean bag kɔ target kɛse mu, na tally wɔ paper so.
seated-toss.intro: Ɛyɛ ntwa a ɛnyɛ ahaw, ɛma nnipa mmienu a wɔtena tebel ho. Wode target a wɔaprin no bɛda tebel no so, na mo mu biara tɔ bean bag a ɛyɛ nwini, anaa sɔks a wɔawia, sɛ ɛbɛkɔ ring no mu. Mo mu biara de tick kyerɛ box wɔ paper so, na sɛ mogyae a, mo nyinaa hwɛ ticks no. Wɔnnyina bere, wɔnnkan nkontaabu wɔ screen so, na wɔnsie anaa wɔnsoma biribiara. Kenkan safety notes no ansa: nneɛma ketewa a ɛwɔ mu yɛ asiane.
howTo: Kenkan safety notes no. Yi bag a ne kata wɔadi mu yie, anaa sɔks a ɛyɛ hɔ tɔ no mu.
Fa "Prin target ne tally sheet" na de paper no to tebel no so mo ntam.
Tena ahodoɔ mu, mo mu baako wɔ fam biara, na monwa mu tɔ bom nnyiɛ mu. Obiara tumi gyae.
Sɛ bean bag no ka ring bi mu a, fa tick kɔ box a ɛwɔ wo kɔlɔm no mu, wɔ saa ring no kɔlɔm no mu.
Sɛ mugyae a, mo nyinaa hwɛ ticks no, anaa fa "Ahome" ma ɛsiesie.
tips: Tena mu nkyerɛ ahinhim sɛ tɔ a ɛyɛ nwini no tumi ka target no a wɔnnnyɛ ntɔnsɛ biara.
Ka tɔ no ho asɛm, na ɛnyɛ nea ɛba: "Ɛno yɛ tɔ a ɛyɛ nwini." Nnipa nyinaa ma tɔ biara ayɛ ahurusi.
Sɔks a wɔawia yɛ kɔkɔɔ, na ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛkyere no ɛwɔ wo nsa mu a ɛnyɛ den. Fa wo nsa to tebel no so ntam nnwa a moreyɛ.
Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔhwɛ, ɔtumi yɛ nea ɔbɛde tick kɔ box no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni sɔkoo, nkontaabu, nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so anaa ahinhim. Wobɛtumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa de awie.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahoɔfɛ sɛ wɔtɔ bean bag?
faq.a: Ɛbɛyɛ, sɛ wobɛhwɛ yie. Fa bag a ne kata wɔadi mu yie anaa sɔks a wɔawia, na mma nneɛma a ɛnyɛ mmoa, mfuw anaa nneɛma ketewa, efisɛ ɛbɛyɛ asiane ma mmofra ketewa ne obiara a ɔde nneɛma guan ne nsa mu. Tena wo ho, tɔ gyinaa tebel no so yie, na mma wo tɔ anifuo, na ma ɔpanin bi nɔ ho ntɛm.

faq.q: Wɔbɛkan biribiara anaa wɔbɛsie biribiara wɔ screen so?
faq.a: Dabi. Tally no wɔ paper so nko, wɔ box a mo ankasa motwa tick no mu. Ɛpeeji no nnyina kan anaa bere, na wɔnsie biribiara, na wɔnsoma biribiara.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ obi remfa mtɔ, anaa bag no ka sɛ ɛnkɔ paper no so?
faq.a: Obiara tumi gyae, na bag a ɛka sɛ ɛnkɔ paper no so no, wɔfa de ahyɛ ntwa a ɛdi hɔ no. Wɔnkan biribiara ama no.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛwɔ paper a wɔaprin no so?
faq.a: Axɛ baako: target kɛse a ne ring 3 din de Ɛbɛn, Mfinimfini ne Akyirikyiri, tebel a kɔlɔm biara ma obi biara ne nkyɛn a ɛyɛ box ketewa a wobɛtwa tick ma ring biara, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa safety ho. Wɔakyerɛw din no wɔ ring no so, enti ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tuntum ne fitaa mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din ansa?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din ahyɛ mu anaa nkɔsoɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ fon, tablet anaa komputa so.

seasonal-pack.name: Bere a Ɛreyɛ So Puzzle Pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Bere a Ɛreyɛ So Puzzle Pack: Krataa Puzzle a Wɔbɛkɔ Krataa Mu
seasonal-pack.h1: Ahyɛde Nhyehyɛe a Ɛfa Bere Ho: Ahyɛde Pɛpɛɛ Abiɛsa Bosome Biara Ma
seasonal-pack.description: Ahyɛde ketewa abiɛsa a wobɛtumi aprinti ma bosome biara a ɛwɔ afe mu: tie nkabom, toa mfonin a ɛyɛ soronko, na de nsuo hyɛ ɛdwene mu. Nhyehyɛe no fi bosome a ɛreyɛ no ase, anaa bosome a wopɛ, anaa ɛberɛ a wopɛ sɛ wo ho ahome. Ɛnhwɛ sika sɛ wobɛprinti.
seasonal-pack.short: Ahyɛde ketewa abiɛsa a wobɛtumi aprinti ma bosome a wopɛ, anaa ɛberɛ a wobɛtɔ ho ahome.
seasonal-pack.players: Mmofra ne akulafo nyinaa, wo nko anaa wɔ ntam
seasonal-pack.intro: Fa bosome bi, na nhwɛso no bɛkyerɛ wo ahyɛde ketewa abiɛsa a wɔfiri saa bosome no mfonin mu: nsɛm mmienu a wobɛde nkyɛn-nkyɛn bɛhyɛ bom, nsɛm anan a wobɛtoa mfonin a ɛyɛ soronko, ne ɛdwene a wobɛde nsuo ahyɛ mu. Nhyehyɛe no fi ɛberɛ a wowɔ ho wɔ wo ɔkwan so no bosome ase. Wobɛtumi aprinti kwan baako, na wobɛyɛ baako, abien anaa abiɛsa, sɛnea wopɛ. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ “Ɛnnɛ yɛ ahomegyeɛ da” a, ɛnni biribi a wobɛyɛ.
howTo: Fa bosome bi, anaa tɔ “Ɛnnɛ yɛ ahomegyeɛ da”.
Hwɛ ahyɛde abiɛsa no, na tɔ “Printi bosome yi ahyɛde”.
Yɛ baako, abien anaa abiɛsa, sɛnea wopɛ, wo ankasa ntɛm.
Fa mfonin a ɛtɔ ho ka ho sɛ wobɛde nkyɛn-nkyɛn, toa mfonin a ɛyɛ soronko, na de nsuo hyɛ ɛdwene kɛse no mu.
Gyina bere biara a wopɛ. Ahomegyeɛ da nso yɛ papa.
tips: Fi ase ne puzzle a ɛyɛ wo ya ɛnnɛ. Baako nko na ɛbɛyɛ.
Ka mfonini biara din kyerɛ nnyɛ kasa sɛ ɛboa.
Fa crayon anaa pencil de. Kɔlɔ biara yɛ.
Kora krataa no ma bere a ɛbɛba, anaa gyae no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni wɔ mu ɔdemo, nkontaabu, ntoma a wɔbɛkan sɛ wodi so, anaa sɛ wobɛhwe ase. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae wɔ ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ kwan pa sɛ woawie.

faq.q: Ɛnim sɛ ɛreyɛ bere bɛn?
faq.a: Dabi. Wo na paw bere no. Ɛnhwɛ da anaa wo beaeɛ.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ nkontaabu anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware?
faq.a: Dabi. Wɔnhwɛ bere, wɔnkontaabu, na wɔnhwɛ nea wobɛkyerɛ wɔ ɔsɛnsɛn so, na wɔnkyerɛ mmuaeɛ. Puzzle biara yɛ mfonini a wobɛhwɛ, akyekyɛ, atwa ano anaa akɔlɔ.

faq.q: Sɛ obiara npɛ puzzle nnɛ a?
faq.a: Paw "Ɛnnɛ yɛ ahomegyé da". Afei, ɛbɛda ɔkyerɛkyerɛ tiawa koraa adi, na ɛnhia sɛ wobɛprin biribi anaa woayɛ biribi.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛwɔ prentɛn krataa no so?
faq.a: Krataa baako a ɛfa bere a wopaw no ho: nhwɛso mmiensa a wɔde ... ne mfiase tiaa baako a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ baako, mmienu anaa nyinaa.

faq.q: Ɛnyɛ tua biribi, na ɛhia sɛ mekyerɛw din anaa?
faq.a: Ɛnyɛ tua biribi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din a wobɛkyerɛw anaa nea wobetwe. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ fon, tabilet anaa kɔmputa so.

decorate-a-card.name: Kaad ahoɔfɛ bom
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Kaad Ahoɔfɛ Bom: Kaad a Wɔbɛprin Ma Ayɛ Ahyɛde
decorate-a-card.h1: Kaad Ahoɔfɛ Bom: Yɛ Baako Ma Obi
decorate-a-card.description: Nnipa 2 de kaad a wɔaprin ahoɔfɛ ma da a wɔbɔ, ayamyɛ anaa ɛnyɛ bere biara, na wɔnam bere koro so kyerɛw nkyerɛase wɔ akyi. Kɔkɔɔ anaa peni nko ara na ɛho hia. Ɛnhia bere, nhwɛso anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne. Ɛnyɛ tua sɛ wobɛprin.
decorate-a-card.short: Kaad a wɔaprin, a wɔde ahoɔfɛ ma nnipa mmienu bom.
decorate-a-card.intro: Ɛyɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ dwodwo ma nnipa mmienu a wɔte wɔn ho nkɔ. Wobɛprin krataa baako a ɛbɛpam mfa ayɛ kaad. Paw ahyɛde, te sɛ da a wɔbɔ anaa ayamyɛ, na wɔde ahoɔfɛ ma kaad no akyiri a ɛfa nsɛm no ho. Afei, kyerɛw nkyerɛase wɔ akyi, mmom no mu baako nkyerɛw nea onni no ka. Fa kɔkɔɔ, kɔlɔ peni anaa fɛlt-tip peni. Kaad a ɛyɛ pefee nni hɔ, na ɛnni bere, ɛnni nsɛnkyerɛnne, na wɔnnoma.
howTo: Paw ahyɛde, afei tɔ "Prin kaad no".
Pam krataa no mfa wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn a ɛwɔ so no so, sɛnea kaad no ano bɛba akyi.
Obi baako de ahoɔfɛ ma kaad no anim, na obi foforo de ma akyi, anaa mo mmienu da so mu ma nea ɛbɛyɛ.
Kyerɛw nkyerɛase bom. Obi baako betumi akyerɛw bere a obi foforo ka nsɛm no.
Gyae bere biara a wopɛ. Kaad a ɛyɛ kwan nni nea ɛyɛ den no so.
tips: Fi nsɛm a ɛwɔ anim no ase, afei fa nhaban, nsoromma anaa nkaa ahyɛ ho, baako baako.
Sɛ obi nni hwɛ sɛ ɔbɛbɔ mfonini a, ɔtumi paw kɔlɔ anaa kyerɛw nkyerɛase.
Ka nea wopɛ wɔ nea obi no ayɛ no ho, mmom sɛ ɛyɛ pefee anaa.
Hwɛ sɛ kaad no wɔ baabi a wobetumi de akɔma obi, anaa kyere sɛ wobɛde ko so wɔ tebul no so ɛnnɛ.

faq.q: Wɔwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni awotwe, nkontaabu, anaa nkɔso a wɔbɛhwɛ, na ɛnni hwehwɛ a wobɛhwɛ. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata sɛ wogyae bere a ɛdɔ kɔ hɔ.

faq.q: Ɛhia sɛ yɛwɔ lepɛ, ntoma anaa nsoromma?
faq.a: Dabi. Kɔkɔɔ, kɔlɔ peni anaa fɛlt-tip peni nko ara na ɛboro. Ɛnhia sɛ wotwitwa, wodi lepɛ anaa wodi ho.

faq.q: Yɛn betumi ayɛ kaad ma ayɛ bi a ɛnkɔ so wɔ tebea no mu?
faq.a: Paw "Ɛnyɛ bere bi", kyerɛw wo ankasa nsɛm anim, anaa de ahoɔfɛ ma kaad no a ɛnyɛ bere biara ho.

faq.q: Wɔbɛkan, wɔbɛtrɛw anaa wɔbɛkora biribi wɔ ekraan no so?
faq.a: Dabi. Nhyehyɛe no kyerɛ kaad no ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nko ara. Wɔnntrɛw nea ɛyɛ, wɔnntrɛw, na wɔnnkora biribi, na kaad a ɛyɛ pefee nni hɔ.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛwɔ prentɛn krataa no so?
faq.a: Krataa baako: kaad a wɔapam mfa, ne nsɛm a wɔapaw ho ne ahoɔfɛ a ɛyɛ kɔkɔ wɔ anim, ne nsɛm ma nkyerɛase ne "Fi" a ɛwɔ akyi. Nnipa mmienu ahyɛde wɔ fam no ase.

faq.q: Ɛnyɛ tua biribi, na ɛhia sɛ mekyerɛw din anaa?
faq.a: Ɛnyɛ tua biribi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din a wobɛkyerɛw anaa nea wobetwe. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ fon, tabilet anaa kɔmputa so.

find-together.name: Hwehwɛ mu
find-together.seoTitle: Hwehwɛ Mu: Nnipa Mmienu Hwehwɛ Nea Ɛbɛkɔ Ho
find-together.h1: Hwehwɛ Mu: Nnipa Mmienu, Yɛ Baako
find-together.description: Nnipa mmienu de ekraan baako, na wɔsesa bere so wɔbɛbɔ kaad mmienu a ɛwɔ mfonini so, de ahwehwɛ nea ɛbɛkɔ ho. Wɔhwehwɛ nea ɛkɔ ho mu, na wɔkan no wɔ baabi baako. Ɛnyɛ tua, ɛnni awotwe anaa nkontaabu.
find-together.short: Sesa bere ne obi a ɔwɔ wo akyi de hwehwɛ mfonini a ɛkɔ ho.
find-together.intro: Kaad no fi ase a wɔde mfonini ka ho, anaa wobetumi de wɔn ma fam. Wo bere so no, wobɛbɔ kaad mmienu. Sɛ wɔkɔ ho a, wohwehwɛɛ nea ɛkɔ ho mu, na bere no kɔ obi foforo nkyɛn. Sɛ wɔn nyinaa nyɛ pɛ a, wɔbɛtena ase kɔsi sɛ wopaw "Sesa wɔn bɛkɔ so", na mo mmienu betumi ahwɛ. Wobetumi agyae bere biara. Nkontaabu a ɛwɔ soro no kɔ so nko ara: nea ɛkɔ ho a mo mmienu wohwehwɛɛ.
howTo: Paw kaad a wobɛde hwehwɛ. Kaad nsia, awe mmiensa, yɛ baabi a ɛyɛ dodo ma wɔahyɛ aseɛ.
Ekraan no ka nea bere no yɛ ma, na ɔdasi baako yɛ ɔkyɛn, na ɔmmienu yɛ nkyɛnkyɛn.
Bɔ kaad mmienu, baako baako. Sɛ wɔkɔ ho a, awe no ayɛ baako.
Sɛ wɔnkɔ ho a, tɔ "Sesa wɔn bɛkɔ so" bere a mo mmienu da so ara. Afei bere no kɔ obi foforo nkyɛn.
Obiara betumi atɔ "Gyae" bere biara. Tɔ "Fi ase bio" ma kaad foforo, anaa tɔ Ahomegye sɛ wobɛgyae.
tips: Fa ho ma mo mmienu nkyɛ, na mo ka mfonini no din mu ka: "Tii kuruwa. Wopɛ nufɔ wɔ wo tii mu anaa?"
Ma obi a wo ho hia no ntɔ akyɛde, bere a ɛbɛyɛ bebree. Kyerɛ no mfonini no, na nkɔ fa ne nsa tɔ.
Paw "Kaadi a wɔde fam ara" sɛ mo mmienu pɛ sɛ mobɛbɔ kaad sɛ mobɛhwehwɛ mfonini.
Obi a ɔbrɛ ntɔ mmerɛ betumi agyae bere a ɔpɛ. Nnipa mmienu no betumi ahwehwɛ nea ɛkɔ ho nso.

faq.q: Wɔwɔ obi a ɔbɛdi nkonim, bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni obi a ɔbɛdi nkonim, efisɛ mohwehwɛ nea ɛkɔ ho sɛ adwuma baako. Ɛnni awotwe, ɛnni nkontaabu, na ɛnni nea woantumi nnye. Nkontaabu no kan nea mo mmienu ahwehwɛ mu nko ara, na wobetumi agyae bere biara.

faq.q: Ɛhia sɛ yɛkae baabi a mfonini no wɔ?
faq.a: Hapa. Oyĩ hyɛ hɔ, nkɔso nkɔ a ɛbɛma wo nhwɛ mmɔfra ahodoɔ nyinaa. Sɛ akyigyinabɔ no ka ho a, wobɛtumi abisa hɔ nea wohunuu ansa na wɔbɛdan hɔ, anaasɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ no bio.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛbɛba sɛ akyigyinabɔ abien yɛ bɔne?
faq.a: Wɔbɛtena hɔ, enti mo mmienu betumi ahwɛ, sɛ mohia bere a ɛbɛyɛ. Ɛnyɛ sɛ biribiara bɛdan wɔn bio. Sɛ woayɛ ahyɛde a, pɛ "Dan wɔn bio" na obi a ɛtwa to no bɛfa akwan no.

faq.q: Wɔbɛkora anaasɛ wɔbɛsoma nneɛma a yɛde di no biara ana?
faq.a: Dabi. Akyigyinabɔ no te saa ara ɛhɔ wɛb nkyɛn nko. Wɔnkora biribiara, wɔnkɔ soro, na wɔnnkan biribiara. Sɛ wo to hɔ a, ɛbɛyera.

faq.q: Akyigyinabɔ no kɛse ampa ara ma nsã a ɛrehwe anaasɛ ɛyɛ nketenkete ntɔ?
faq.a: Akyigyinabɔ biara yɛ nʼanim mpɛn 64 ne soro, na ɛkɔ so kɔsi sɛ eyi ɛbɛtumi kɔ. Nea wɔde nsɛnkyerɛ nkɔ ketewa ne akontabuo kyerɛ no, wɔbɛtumi atie akyigyinabɔ biara bere a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nea ɛwɔ mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaasɛ ehia sɛ mekyerɛw ne din?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia akaunti, din a wɔkyerɛw anaasɛ nea wɔbɛtow fa. Ɛtumi yɛ adwuma wɛb browser wɔ fon, tablet anaasɛ komputa so.

story-dice.name: Asɛm dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Asɛm Dice: Mfonini Ntwa a Wɔde Kyerɛ Asɛm
story-dice.h1: Asɛm Dice: Ka Asɛm Bi Kyerɛ Wɔ Mfonini So
story-dice.description: Mfonini dice 3 anaa 4 a wɔde kyerɛ asɛm wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu. Ɛnhia sɛ wokenkan, nni mmuae a ɛteɛ, nni bere, nni nkontaabu. Mɔ dice no bio, anaa gyae. Ɛyɛ ahofadi sɛ wobɛtena anaa wobɛprin.
story-dice.short: Mɔ mfonini dice na mo nyinaa ka asɛm bi, wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu.
story-dice.players: Nnipa 2 anaa nnipa pii, anaa ɔpanin ne abofra
story-dice.intro: Mfonini 3 anaa 4 bɛda adi sɛ dice. Mo nyinaa mu ka asɛm bi a ɛde ano, wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu. Asɛm no tumi yɛ tiaa anaa ɛyɛ nea ɛda nokware so. Asɛm pɛyɛ nni hɔ, na obiara nhia sɛ ɔkyerɛ din anaa ɔkae biribiara. Fa "Mɔ dice no bio" ma mfonini foforɔ, na obiara tumi gyae.
howTo: Yi dice 3 anaa 4. 3 ne ɛyɛ mmerɛ.
Mo nyinaa hwɛ mfonini no. Fa baako sɛ wopɛ sɛ mofi ase wɔ so.
Monwa mu ka asɛm a ɛde mfonini no, wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu. Asɛm baako ma obiara na ɛboro so.
Obiara tumi gyae. Fa "Gyae" na ɛdi hɔ a ɛbɛdi so no bɛfi ase.
Fa "Mɔ dice no bio" ma mfonini foforɔ bere biara a wopɛ, anaa fa "Ahome" ma ɛba awieɛ.
tips: Bisa asɛmmisa sɛ ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛtɔ mmuae bio: "Ntoma no bɛkɔ he?"
Ka nea ɔdi kan no ho ka ho, kyerɛ mmom sɛ wobɛsesa no. Asɛm biara yɛ.
Asɛm bi bɛtumi ayɛ ɔkae a ɛyɛ nokware. Mfonini yɛ ɔkwan pa a wɔfi ase so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni sɔkoo, nkontaabu, nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so anaa ahinhim. Wobɛtumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa de awie.

faq.q: Ɛsɛ sɛ mekenkan anaa mekyerɛ din ma mfonini no?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛdwuma nko ara wɔ mfonini no so. Nnipa tumi ka, kyerɛkyerɛ anaa kɔka nea mfonini no kae ama wɔn nkutoo. Obiara nhyɛ no sɛ ɔkyerɛ din anaa ɔkae biribiara.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ obi remfa ne bere nnwa?
faq.a: WanƐ hia no, wobɛtumi apue bere biara a enni nkyerɛkyerɛ. Ɛnam so, kɔ so, na nea ɛbɛtoa so no betumi afi ase anaasɛ wosan mfa ntetekɔ.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ kwan a wɔfa mpapahwɛ so yɛ no?
faq.a: Yiw. Mpapahwɛ baako wɔ mfonini ahodoɔ a ɛyɛ dodow 16 wɔ nsɛnkyeneɛ 4 mu. Fa nsɛnkyeneɛ baako, anaasɛ sɛ wotwa mfonini no, na wɔde bi aba mu ma wo.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛhia sɛ woyɛ kwan a wobɛka?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛnhia akaunt, nkyerɛwbɔ anaasɛ sɛ wode bɛtow. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔhwɛfo (web browser) so wɔ fon, tabelɛt anaasɛ kɔmpiuta so.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Nsɛm ne Mfonin Nkabom
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Nsɛm ne Mfonin Nkabom: Fa Nsɛm Di Mfonin Ho
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Nsɛm ne Mfonin Nkabom: Fa Nsɛm no Kɔ Mfonin a Ɛkyerɛ So
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Fa English nsɛm kɔ mfonin a ɛkyerɛ wɔn, na tie nsɛm biara a wɔka sɛ wɔrekenkan. Mfonin no da hɔ, na biribiara nni bere, nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa ɔkwan a wɔde bɛhunu nnansa a wayɛ. Ɛnhwɛ sika sɛ wobɛtumi atu ase na wobɛprinti.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Fa nsɛm biara kɔ mfonin a ɛkyerɛ no, na tie sɛ wɔkenkan nsɛm no.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Ɔpanyin baako, anaa abusua a wɔreka ho ahyɛ mu.
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Wɔda mfonin anan anaa nsia adi, na nsɛm English a ɛfata wɔn no wɔ ahyɛde foforo mu. Tɔ nsɛm, na tɔ ɛdwene a ɛkyerɛ so; anaa tɔ ɛdwene kan, na tɔ nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ no. Nkabom a ɛyɛ pɛ no bɛtena ho wɔ ntɛm a ɛyɛ nhyehyɛe no ntam, na ɛwɔ ntwa kɛse ne asɛm “Ayɛ nkabom”. Tɔ “Kenkan” a ɛwɔ nsɛm biara ho na wɔbɛkenkan no. Wɔnhwɛ bere, nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa nsɛm a wɔatwe, na nnansa a ɛnyɛ yɛ pɛ no nso ankɔ so ankasa.
howTo: Paw mfonin anan anaa nsia. Anan no ne ɛyɛ kwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw.
Tɔ nsɛm, na tɔ ɛdwene a ɛkyerɛ so. Anaa tɔ ɛdwene kan, na tɔ nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ no.
Nkabom no tena ho. Tɔ a ɛnfata no bɛtwe ankasa, enti sɔ hwɛ foforo.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotie nsɛm no a, tɔ “Kenkan” a ɛwɔ nsɛm biara ho, sɛ wo ntoso yɛ saa adwuma no.
Tɔ “Mfonin foforo” sɛ wopɛ nhyehyɛe foforo, anaa “Fi foforo” sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔyi nkabom nyinaa. “San de” bɛsan de nkabom a edi kan no.
tips: Kenkan nsɛm biara ka ho pɛ ansa na wobɛfa ho, na ka asɛm wɔ ɛdwene no ho.
Abusua bɛtumi ayɛ nnwuma a wɔbɛyɛ bere biara. Obiara bɛpaw nsɛm baako anaa ɛdwene baako.
Fa nsɛm a wunim dedaw kan, na gyae afoforo ma akyire.

faq.q: Wɔwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Nni. Wɔnni bere, nkontaabu, nhyehyɛe a wɔkɔ so anaa nnwonwa. Wobɛtumi agyae bere biara, na ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛtumi afa so awie sɛ wogyae fã mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ mmofra nkwa?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ ma ɔpanyin a ɔresua English nsɛm foforo anaa ɔresan kɔ nsɛm a ɔsuaa no ho, ne abusua a wɔreka ho ahyɛ mu. Wɔnkyerɛw no ma mmofra.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ me ntoso ntumi nkenkan nsɛm?
faq.a: Bɔtɔn “Kenkan” no de deng a wo browser no wɔ no na ɛbɛfa. Sɛ browser no rentumi nkasa a, bɔtɔn no remmfa, na ɛdwene no bɛyɛ adwuma a ɛnni ho.

faq.q: Wɔwɔ printi a ɛyɛ pepa?
faq.a: Dabi. Pepa baako wɔ mfonin anan nsia ne nsɛm nsia wɔ so, a wobɛtumi atwa anaa wo de bɛfa nkyɛn-nkyɛn.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ɛnhwɛ sika, na ɛsɛ sɛ metu ka?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛnhwɛ sika, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wode akaunt, nkyerɛwdeɛ anaa nsɔ biribiara a wobɛfa. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ foonu, tablet anaa komputa so.

sort-together.name: Bom hyehyɛ mu
sort-together.seoTitle: Nhyehyɛe Agyinatuo: Hyehyɛ Mmoa Ma Nkurɔfo Akɛse

Bue nea ɔfrɛ no no wɔ screen kɛse bi so. Klik "Next picture" so na kyerɛ mfonini biara ne ne din.
Agodifo de sika, bɔtn anaa agyiraehyɛde kata mfonini a ɛne no hyia a ɛwɔ wɔn kaad so no so.
Obiara a ɔhyɛ toatoa so, anaa kaad no nyinaa ma no nya anigye. Wɔn a wɔadi nkogu biara nni saa nkyerɛase yi mu: kɔ so di agoru kosi sɛ obiara benya line.
tips: Fa token akɛse te sɛ checkers anaa bottle caps di dwuma. Ebetumi ayɛ den sɛ wobɛfa bɔton nketewa.
Bobɔ mfonini no din na ka biribi fa ho: "Ahyɛmma a wɔde po so hyɛn tu. Hena na wakɔ akɔtena hyɛmma mu?"
Fa nnipa a ɛyɛ den sɛ wobehu wɔn a wɔbɛn screen no tena ase, na fa aboafo ne agodifo a wohia wɔn bom.
Ahinanan akron dɔɔso ma akuw dodow no ara. Ma adesua no nyɛ simma 20 kosi 30.

faq.q: Ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi atu mmirika wɔ picture bingo mu wɔ fie a wɔhwɛ wɔn?
faq.a: Print kaad biako wɔ obiara a ɔbɔ bɔɔl no mu, fa nea ɔfrɛ no no to screen kɛse a wowɔ no so, na frɛ mfonini ahorow no nkakrankakra, bɔ emu biara din. Di agorɔ kɔsi sɛ obiara bɛnya line, enti wɔrennyaw obiara.

faq.q: So ɛyɛ nea wontua hwee sɛ wobetintim?
faq.a: Aane. Print nkrataa dodow biara a wuhia, mpɛn dodow biara a wopɛ, ma w’ankasa anaa kuw de di dwuma.

faq.q: So nkurɔfo betumi adi agoru a wɔnkenkan ade?
faq.a: Aane. Ahinanan biara yɛ mfonini kɛse, na wɔde ne din ahyɛ ase ma wɔn a wɔpɛ nsɛmfua.

picnic-planner.name: Picnic planner
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Picnic Planner: Yi Mfonini a Ɛfata Akɔnnibea
picnic-planner.h1: Picnic Planner: Yi Mfonini, Then Fa Wɔn Ho Ananmu
picnic-planner.description: Yi aduane ne nneɛma a wobɛyɛ wɔ akɔnnibea mu mfonini, then ma wɔafa wɔn ho ananmu wɔ anigye mu. Biribiara nni bere so. Ɛyɛ free sɛ wobɛdi anaasɛ wobɛprint.
picnic-planner.short: Yi aduane ne akɔnnibea nneɛma mfonini, then fa wɔn ho ananmu.
picnic-planner.players: Wo nko, anaasɛ mmienu mo ho abɔ
picnic-planner.intro: Twa aduane ne nneɛma a wobɛyɛ mfonini sɛ wobɛde bɛhyɛ akɔnnibea kyebɔ mu, a ɛbɛtumi ahyɛ nneɛma enum. Nsɛm a wɔkyerɛw wɔ hɔ kyerɛ nea ɛwɔ kyebɔ no mu, te sɛ "Yɛn akɔnnibea: paanoo, warankɔ, apɔkyɛ ne sɛnkyerɛnne." Afei twa "Ma yɛnnyina yɛn akɔnnibea so" ama wɔafa mfonini a wopaw no ho ananmu anigye mu. Mfonini no nkɔ soro, na wɔrenkyɛ, wɔrenkora anaasɛ wɔrenkora nkontaa. "Print yɛn akɔnnibea list" de nkyerɛwde a wopaw nneɛma no ba, ne nkyerɛwde a wobɛtɔ sɛ ɛbɛma wo ntumi ahyɛ nneɛma biara a wɔbɛkɔ nsa.
howTo: Twa aduane anaasɛ adwuma bi a wobɛyɛ mfonini. Ɛbɛkɔ kyebɔ mu.
Twa mfonini a ɛwɔ kyebɔ mu sɛ wobɛyi no fi hɔ.
Yi nneɛma abien anaa ɛboro, afei twa "Ma yɛnnyina yɛn akɔnnibea so".
Twa mfonini abien a ɛte sɛ, mfonini no nkɔ soro, enti ɛnhia sɛ wokae biribiara.
Twa "Print yɛn akɔnnibea list" ama wɔde nkyerɛwde a wobɛtɔ.
tips: Bisa nkurɔfoɔ a mowɔ nʼhyia sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde bɛba, na mo mmienu muyi mfonini no ho.
Kasa fa mfonini biara ho bere a ɛrekɔ kyebɔ mu: "Wokae kɔkɔ a yɛtuu wɔ mpoano no ho?"
Wɔ nkyerɛwde so no, nkyerɛwde a ɛnni nsɛm no ye nneɛma foforɔ a wopɛ sɛ wode bɛba, anaasɛ wɔ din mma.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere bi, nhwɛso, anaasɛ nea ɔdi nkonyaa wɔ hɔ anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. Biribiara nni bere so, biribiara nni nhwɛso, na obiara nni nkonyaa. Ɛnni mfomsoɔ anaasɛ aporɔ wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔyɛ ho.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ aduane nhyehyɛe bi anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛyɛ mfonini nhyehyɛe ma akɔnnibea, a wɔbɛkasa fa ho na wɔafa kɔ nkyerɛwde so. Ɛnkyerɛ sɛ obi nni nea ɔbɛdi.

faq.q: Wɔbɛkora anaasɛ wɔbɛsoma mfonini a yɛpaw no ana?
faq.a: Dabi. Kyebɔ no te saa ara ɛhɔ wɛb nkyɛn nko. Wɔnkora, wɔnsoma anaasɛ wɔnkɔ soro, na ɛbɛyera sɛ woto saa nkyɛn yi hɔ.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde so version bi anaa?
faq.a: Ɛwɔ hɔ. "Print yɛn akɔnnibea list" prints nkyerɛwde baako, wɔ A4 anaasɛ US Letter so. Ɛkyerɛ mfonini a wopaw no ne tick box biara, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnni nsɛm ama nea afoa.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free, na ehia sɛ mekyerɛw ne din?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia akaunti, din a wɔkyerɛw anaasɛ nea wɔbɛtow fa. Ɛtumi yɛ adwuma wɛb browser wɔ fon, tablet anaasɛ komputa so.

scrapbook.name: Scrapbook
scrapbook.seoTitle: Scrapbook: Bɔ Abusua Mfonini Ho Ananmu, Kɔ Nkyɛn Biara
scrapbook.h1: Scrapbook: Fa Wo Mfonini ne Nsɛmfua Ka Ho, Then Kɔ Nkyɛn Biara
scrapbook.description: Yi wo abusua mfonini a ɛyɛ mmienu kɔsi mmienu abien (2-12) wɔ wo device so, na ma wɔayɛ sɛ nhoma, nsɛmfua kakra wɔ mfonini biara ase. Wɔnkɔ soro. Ɛyɛ free sɛ wobɛprint.
scrapbook.short: Kɔ nkyɛn wo abusua mfonini ho ananmu, te sɛ nhoma.
scrapbook.players: Wo nko, anaasɛ mmienu mo ho abɔ
scrapbook.intro: Paw mfonini 2 kosi 12 a ɛwɔ wo ho wɔ saa dwumadie yi so. Mfonini biara bɛyɛ krataa baako wɔ nwoma no mu, ɛkɛse yiye ma wohu, na sɛ wopɛ a, wobetumi de nsɛm kakra ahyɛ ase. Fa “Krataa a atwa so” ne “Krataa a ɛba so” ma wo ntwa krataa, anaa fa wo kwan nkotow no so. Fa “Hwɛ ho bom” ma wo ne nea woayɛ no nyinaa ahwɛ nwoma no ne nsɛm nko ara. Wo mfonini no te saa dwumadie yi so. Wɔnnkɔ kwan, na wɔnnsie wɔn, na nwoma no ware ara bere a woato saa krataa yi mu. “Prin nwoma no” bɛprint mfonini baako ne ne nsɛm wɔ krataa biara so, ne krataa nɔma.
howTo: Tia “Paw mfonini” na paw mfonini 2 kosi 12. Bisa ansa na wode mfonini a ɛfa obi a onnim sɛ obetumi aka ho anka wʼankasa nko ara.
Twa krataa no so de “Krataa a atwa so” ne “Krataa a ɛba so”, anaa de mpaboa nkotow a ɛwɔ ne so akyi ne anim.
Fa nsɛm kakra ahyɛ mfonini ase sɛ wopɛ. Fa “Kɔ anim” anaa “Kɔ akyire” sesa nhyehyɛe no.
Tia “Hwɛ ho bom” de yi nsiesie nneɛma no fi hɔ na hwɛ nwoma no bom.
Tia “Prin nwoma no” de nwoma no ayɛ krataa a wobɛhwɛ, anaa tia “Yi nwoma no mfiri” sɛ woawie. Biribiara nni hɔ a wɔbɛkora ho.
tips: Paw mfonini a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛyɛ anigye na wodi wɔn kan no: turo, anwonwadea, anaa beaeɛ a wɔpɛ. Ka nea ɛfa krataa biara ho wɔ bere a woretwa krataa no so.
Ma nea woayɛ ma ɔnka nsɛm kakra ama krataa biara, ɛwom sɛ ɛyɛ ankasa baako, na kyerɛw no sɛdeɛ ɔka no pefee.
Sɛ wodi so wɔ krataa so a, krataa a wɔaprint no betumi akɔ foldɛ mu, na abusua no betumi ahyɛ wɔn ankasa mfonini ne nkyerɛwee ho.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere, dwetɛ, anaa nea ɔdi nkonim wɔ hɔ anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. Wɔnhunu bere, wɔnhwɛ dwetɛ, na wɔnnkan biribi, na obiara nnya nkonim. Krataa nɔma no wɔ hɔ de boa wo sɛ wo ho bɛhu baabi a woreka wɔ nwoma no mu ara.

faq.q: Wɔkora, wɔsoma anaa wɔfa yɛn mfonini ne nkyerɛwee?
faq.a: Dabi. Krataa yi nkutaho ara na ɛkenkan mfonini no, na wɔnsoma, wɔnkora anaa wɔnfa kɔ baabi biara. Nkyerɛwee no nso wɔ hɔ de sɛ krataa no bue ara. Bere a woato krataa no mu no, nwoma no nso ware.

faq.q: Yɛntumi nprint nwoma no anaa?
faq.a: Yiw. “Prin nwoma no” prints mfonini baako ne ne nkyerɛwee wɔ krataa biara so, ne krataa nɔma. Paw A4 anaa US Letter wɔ print mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ tẽ anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ tẽ, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wokyerɛw din anaa wode ka ho, na wonhyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛtow hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ wo foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

collage-board.name: Collage board
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage Board: Nnipa 2 Bɛtow Mfonini Wɔ Bere Mu
collage-board.h1: Collage Board: Tow Mfonini Wɔ Board Baako So Wɔ Bere Mu
collage-board.description: Nnipa 2 betow mfonini a wɔatwa wɔ board baako so wɔ bere mu. Tia ntwa a wɔatwa, na tia beaeɛ a ɛnni biribiara. Ɛnni dwetɛ anaa nkonim. Ɛyɛ tẽ sɛ wobɛtu ne sɛ wobɛprint.
collage-board.short: Tow mfonini wɔ board baako so wɔ bere mu.
collage-board.intro: Nnipa 2 bɛtena ho bom, wɔ board a beaeɛ 12 wɔ so, ne tray a mfonini a wɔatwa 8 wɔ so. Tia ntwa a wɔatwa, na tia beaeɛ a ɛnni biribiara, na mfonini no kɔ hɔ. Afei, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a ɔtow no nkɔ ɔfoforɔ nso. Mfonini biara wɔ n’ankasa ntɛmpɔw, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔkɔkɔɔ anaa ɔsin tẽẽ, sɛdeɛ board no bɛkyerɛ nea ɔtow hɔ nti a, na ɛnnyɛ ɔhɔ no nti. Obiara betumi apasa, na wobetumi asan adi ano ɔkyin. Biribiara nni hɔ a wɔbɛbɔ bere, de dwetɛ, anaa sie. “Prin board no” de board a ɛnni biribiara ne mfonini a wɔbɛtwa no prints.
howTo: Tia ntwa a ɛwɔ tray no mu. Ɛbɛkyerɛ “Paw” bere a wɔapaw no.
Tia beaeɛ a ɛnni biribiara wɔ board no so. Ntwa no kɔ hɔ, na ɔfoforɔ bɛtra.
Obiara betumi ato “Pasa” bere biara, anaa “San fa ɔkyin tow no” de yi ɔkyin tow no.
Tia “Mfonini foforɔ” sɛ wopɛ tray foforɔ. Mfonini a wɔatow dada no bɛtena baabi a ɛwɔ.
Tia “Fi ase bio” de yi board no mfiri, na “San de hyɛ hɔ” sɛ woasesa wo adwen.
tips: Ka din a ɛfa mfonini biara ho bere a ɛrekɔ fam, te sɛ “kuruwa no ne fie no ntam”. Ka asɛm no ma ɛnyɛ adwuma a wɔyɛ ne nnipa nyinaa.
Ma nnipa 2 no nyinaa nkɔpaw ntwa, ne beaeɛ no nso, na obiara nni ne nkɛntɛnso.
Sɛ wobɛyɛ so wɔ krataa so a, nea ɔkenkan betumi aboa de yɛ mfonini 8 no, na afei hyɛ wɔn wɔ bokɔ a wɔaprint no so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere, dwetɛ, anaa nea ɔdi nkonim wɔ hɔ anaa?
faq.a: Dabi. Wɔnhunu bere, wɔnhwɛ dwetɛ, na wɔnnkan biribi, na obiara nnya nkonim. Board a mfonini wɔ beaeɛ nyinaa so no ara ne nea ɛma wɔka sɛ aboɔ.

faq.q: Wɔkora anaa wɔsoma mfonini a yɛtow no?
faq.a: Dabi. Board no ntena krataa yi so nko ara. Wɔnkora, wɔnsoma anaa wɔnkan no, na ɛbɛkɔ bere a woato krataa no mu.

faq.q: Yɛbɛhu sɛn sɛ mfonini bi yɛ obi ne?
faq.a: Obiara wɔ ne ntɛmpɔw. Ɔkan a ɔtow mfonini no nkɔ anim no mfonini a wɔ ɔkɔkɔɔ wɔ mfuturo mu, na ɔkan a ɔtɔ so 2 no mfonini no ɛwɔ ɔsin tẽẽ, na wɔkyerɛ din biara wɔ board no soro.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ krataa mu version?
faq.a: Yiw. “Prin board no” prints board a ɛnni biribiara sɛ beaeɛ 12, ne mfonini 8 a ɛwɔ fam wɔ ɔkɔkɔɔ kɛse koro so, ne ntwa a wɔbɛtwa no. Ɔpanyin betumi ayɛ ntwa no.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ tẽ anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ tẽ, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wokyerɛw din anaa wode ka ho, na wonhyɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛtow hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ wo foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

garden-planner.name: Garden planner
garden-planner.seoTitle: Garden Planner: Hyehyɛ Afuo Fi Afifidua Mfonini So
garden-planner.h1: Garden Planner: Paw Mfonini Na Hyehyɛ Afuo
garden-planner.description: Paw afifidua ne afuo nneɛma mfonini, na afei hyɛ wɔn wɔ afuo beaeɛ 12 mu. Tia mfonini, na afei tia beaeɛ. Ɛnni dwetɛ anaa nkonim. Ɛyɛ tẽ sɛ wobɛtu ne sɛ wobɛprint.
garden-planner.short: Paw afifidua mfonini na hyehyɛ afuo a ɛwɔ beaeɛ 12.
garden-planner.players: Ɔkorɔ baako, anaa nnipa 2 wɔ ho bom
garden-planner.intro: Chagua picha kutoka kwenye sinia ya mimea na vitu vya bustani, kisha gusa kitanda ili kuweka kila picha mahali pake. Kiwanja kina vitanda kumi na viwili, na kitanda kimoja kina picha moja. Muhtasari kwa maneno unaonyesha kilichomo kwenye mpango, kwa mfano "Mpango wako una alizeti 3, waridi 2 na mti 1." Hakuna muda, alama wala hifadhi, na hakuna zamu. Hii ni ramani ya picha ya kuzungumzia, si ushauri wa kupanda. "Chapisha mpango" huchapisha vitanda pamoja na picha ulizochagua, pamoja na vitanda tupu vya kuchora na mistari ya maelezo.
howTo: Gusa picha kwenye sinia. Itaonyesha "Imechaguliwa" ikiwa imechaguliwa.
Gusa kitanda. Picha itawekwa hapo, na chaguo litakuwa limekamilika.
Ili kubadilisha kitanda, chagua picha nyingine kisha gusa kitanda. Ili kufuta kitanda, kigusa bila kuchagua picha.
Gusa "Anza upya" ili kutoa kila kitanda, na "Rudisha" ukibadili nia.
Gusa "Chapisha mpango" kwa nakala ya karatasi ya kiwanja na muhtasari.
tips: Zungumzia kila picha inapowekwa, kwa mfano "alizeti inakwenda karibu na nyumba ya ndege". Kuzungumza kunafanya shughuli iwe ya pamoja.
Mwache kila mtu achague picha kwa zamu, au chagueni picha pamoja, ili wote wawe na sauti katika kiwanja.
Kwenye karatasi, vitanda tupu ni kwa ajili ya kuchora mawazo yenu, na mistari ya maelezo ni kwa chochote mnachotaka kukumbuka.

faq.q: Je, hii ni ushauri wa kupanda?
faq.a: Hapana. Hii ni ramani ya picha ya kuzungumzia, si ushauri wa kupanda. Haisemi lini, wapi wala jinsi ya kupanda chochote, kwa sababu hilo linategemea mahali unapoishi.

faq.q: Je, kuna kipima muda, alama au mshindi?
faq.a: Hapana. Hakuna kinachopimwa muda, kupewa alama, kukadiriwa wala kuhesabiwa, na hakuna mshindi. Kiwanja kilichojaa hakipati ujumbe maalum.

faq.q: Je, picha tunazochagua zinahifadhiwa au kutumwa?
faq.a: Hapana. Mpango unabaki kwenye ukurasa huu pekee. Hauhifadhiwi, hauwekwi mtandaoni wala kuhesabiwa, na unapotea ukifunga ukurasa.

faq.q: Je, kuna toleo la karatasi?
faq.a: Ndiyo. "Chapisha mpango" huchapisha ukurasa mmoja, kwenye A4 au US Letter. Unaonyesha vitanda kumi na viwili pamoja na picha ulizochagua, muhtasari kwa maneno, na mistari tupu ya maelezo.

faq.q: Je, ni bure, na ninahitaji kujisajili?
faq.a: Ndiyo, ni bure, na hakuna akaunti, usajili wala upakuaji. Inafanya kazi kwenye kivinjari cha wavuti kwenye simu, kompyuta kibao au kompyuta.

coloring-wall.name: Ukuta wa kupaka rangi kwa kikundi
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Ukuta wa Kupaka Rangi kwa Kikundi: Picha Moja kwa Mikono Mingi
coloring-wall.h1: Ukuta wa Kupaka Rangi kwa Kikundi: Picha Kubwa Moja, Iliyopakwa Pamoja
coloring-wall.description: Chapisha picha moja kubwa kwenye kurasa kadhaa, ili familia, darasa au nyumba ya wazee iweze kupaka ukuta mmoja pamoja. Ni bure kuchapisha. Hakuna kipima muda wala alama.
coloring-wall.short: Chapisha picha moja kubwa kwenye kurasa kwa watu wengi kupaka rangi.
coloring-wall.intro: Chagua picha kutoka kurasa za kupaka rangi, pamoja na ukuta wa kurasa 4, 6 au 9. Chapisha ukuta: ukurasa wa kwanza unaonyesha jinsi ya kuukusanya, na kila ukurasa mwingine ni sehemu moja ya picha hiyo kubwa, ukiwa na lebo kama A1 kwenye kona yake. Kila mtu anapaka ukurasa mmoja au zaidi, kwa rangi yoyote na mtindo wowote. Kisha kurasa zinapangwa kwa lebo zao na kuunganishwa kwa kibandiko upande wa nyuma. Hakuna muda, alama wala hifadhi.
howTo: Chagua picha, kisha chagua idadi ya kurasa ukuta utakuwa nayo.
Soma ramani kwenye skrini, inayoonyesha mahali kila lebo inapoenda.
Gusa "Chapisha ukuta" na uchapishe kurasa zote.
Mpe kila mtu ukurasa mmoja au zaidi wa kupaka. Rangi na mitindo hazihitaji kufanana.
Panga kurasa kwa lebo zake, na uziunganishe kwa kibandiko upande wa nyuma.
tips: Wape watu wanaotaka kazi tulivu kurasa zenye mistari rahisi zaidi, na wale wanaofurahia kurasa zenye mambo mengi wapewe zile zenye shughuli nyingi.
Ning'iniza ukuta mahali ambapo kila mtu anaweza kuuona, na zungumzieni sehemu zake pamoja.
Chagua ukuta mdogo kwa meza ndogo, na mkubwa zaidi kwa chumba.

faq.q: Je, kuna kipima muda, alama au mshindi?
faq.a: Hapana. Hakuna kinachopimwa muda, kupewa alama wala kuhesabiwa, na hakuna mshindi. Ukuta ni picha tu ambayo watu wengi wameipaka.

faq.q: Je, kurasa zinahifadhiwa au kutumwa popote?
faq.a: Hapana. Ukuta unatengenezwa kwenye ukurasa huu pekee. Hauhifadhiwi, hauwekwi mtandaoni wala kuhesabiwa, na unapotea ukifunga ukurasa.

faq.q: Je, rangi lazima zifanane?
faq.a: Hapana. Kila mtu anaweza kutumia rangi yoyote na mtindo wowote. Kurasa bado zinaungana kuwa picha moja.

faq.q: Je, kuna toleo la karatasi?
faq.a: Ndiyo. Ukuta uliochapishwa ndio mchezo mzima: ukurasa wa kwanza wenye hatua na ramani, na ukurasa mmoja kwa kila sehemu ya picha.

faq.q: Je, ni bure, na ninahitaji kujisajili?
faq.a: Ndiyo, ni bure, na hakuna akaunti, usajili wala upakuaji. Inafanya kazi kwenye kivinjari cha wavuti kwenye simu, kompyuta kibao au kompyuta.

quiet-shapes.name: Fumbo la maumbo tulivu
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Fumbo la Maumbo Tulivu: Ingiza Maumbo Ndani ya Picha
quiet-shapes.h1: Fumbo la Maumbo Tulivu: Ingiza Vipande Ndani ya Picha
quiet-shapes.description: Ingiza maumbo rahisi ndani ya mstari wa nyumba, mashua, samaki na mengineyo. Gusa kipande, kisha nafasi yenye umbo sawa. Hakuna kipima muda wala alama. Ni bure kucheza na kuchapisha.
quiet-shapes.short: Ingiza maumbo rahisi ndani ya picha, kwa mwendo wako mwenyewe.
quiet-shapes.intro: Ɛyɛ mfonini a wɔatwa ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, te sɛ fie, ɔpɔ anaa rɔkɛt, na wɔakyekyɛ mu ayɛ beae pii. Beae biara wɔ ɔkyɛde a tebea ne ho yɛ pɛ: triangle kɛse anaa kakra, square, parallelogram anaa rectangle. Fa ɔkyɛde biako, then fa beae a tebea ne no yɛ pɛ biako, na ɛbɛfɛre hɔ. Beae no mpo hyɛ ɔkyɛde no yiye ma wo, enti ɛnhia sɛ wotu anaa wosɔre. Sɛ ɔkyɛde no tebea nnyɛ beae no tebea a, ɛbɛtena tray no mu, na ɛbɛka asɛm kakra ho. Biribiara nntu bere, na wɔnnhwɛ nkontaabu anaa wɔnnkora. “Bɔ saa mfonini yi” bɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne ɔkyɛde no wɔ peji biako so, na obi bɛtumi ade loro anaa ɔtwa so.
howTo: Fa ɔkyɛde biako a ɛwɔ tray no mu. Ɛbɛkyerɛ “Wɔapaw” bere a wɔapaw no.
Fa beae a ɛwɔ mfonini no mu. Sɛ tebea no yɛ pɛ a, ɔkyɛde no bɛfɛre hɔ.
Sɛ ɛnyɛ pɛ a, sɔ beae foforo hwehwɛ. Sɔhwɛ anni biribiara a wobɛtumi aka.
Fa ɔkyɛde a ɛwɔ mfonini no mu de bɛsan akɔ tray no mu, anaa fa “Fi ase bio” de ayi wɔn nyinaa.
Sɛ beae biara wɔ ne ɔkyɛde a, mfonini no awie. Fa “Ɔkyɛde foforo” ama mfonini foforo, anaa fa “Ma ho ntew” ama wo ntɛn.
tips: Ma nsɛnkyerɛnne nkɔ so sɛ wohwɛ beae biara. Yi wɔn ankɔ sɛ wopɛ asɛm kɛse, na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nsɛmmisa a wɔde ɔfa mfonini no pɛ nko ara.
Fi ase wɔ ɔkyɛde kɛse no so, te sɛ triangle kɛse ne rectangle tenten. Ɔkyɛde kakra no ara di kan a, ɛyɛ ɔkyɛde a ɛtɔ so.
Ka mfonini no din kɛkɛ bere a wɔreyɛ: “triangle, square, rectangle a ɛyɛ tenten”. Ka kasa yɛ ade a obiara bɛtumi ayɛ ho.
Sɛ wode impapa rebɛyɛ a, de loro abien anaa abiasa kyerɛ ɔkyɛde no, anaa twa wɔn ma ɛnyɛ den, na obi a ɔbɛboa wo akyerɛ wo.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere ntwentwen, mmuae anaa nkontaabu bere?
faq.a: Daabi. Biribiara ntwentwen bere, nkontaabu anaa mmuae. Ɔkyɛde a ɛnfɛre no ɛnkɔ hɔ, na wobɛtumi agyae bere biara a wopɛ.

faq.q: Wɔsie anaa wɔsoma ade a yɛayɛ no?
faq.a: Daabi. Mfonini no te saa ase wɔ saa peji yi nko ara. Wɔnnsie, wɔnnsoma anaa wɔnnkan, na ɛbɛwu sɛ wosɔ peji no.

faq.q: Beae no kɛse ma nsa a ɛbɔ anaa screen kakra?
faq.a: Wɔde mfonini no kɛse sɛnea screen no tumi ma. Beae biara yɛ bɔtum a wobɛtumi de nsa anaa Tab key so asɛe. Ɔkyɛde a ɛwɔ tray no mu yɛ bɔtum kɛse a ɛwɔ peji no so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ paper version bi?
faq.a: Aane. “Bɔ saa mfonini yi” bɔ mfonini biako wɔ peji biako so: ɔpɔ no ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ ne so, ne ɔkyɛde a wɔayɛ wɔn kɛse pɛ wɔ ne ho. Loro ɔkyɛde no, anaa twa wɔn ma ɛnyɛ den. Obi kɛse bɛtumi aboa wo wɔ twaa no mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mede me din ka ho?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia account, din a wɔkyerɛw anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

calm-breathing.name: Ɔhome a ɛyɛ komm
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Ahome Mmerɛ a Yɛbɛkyekyɛ Ne Ho Ma Nnipa Nyinaa
calm-breathing.description: Ahomegye a ɛyɛ brɛoo na ɛyɛ komm a wɔde kyɛ ade: kurukuruwa a ɛyɛ brɛoo nyin na ɛso tew ahome asia. Wofi ase, na wubetumi agyae bere biara.
calm-breathing.short: Kurukuruwa a ɛyɛ brɛoo a wobɛhome ka ho. Fi ase na gyae bere a wopɛ.
calm-breathing.intro: Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, dwumadi a eye sen biara ne sɛ wobɛhome komm. Tap "Start", afei home bere a kurukuruwa no nyin na fi adi bere a ɛretew no. Paw ɔkwan a wobɛfa so akɔ brɛoo anaasɛ wobɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm. Ɛnyɛ ayaresa, asomdwoe bere a wɔde bɛkyɛ kɛkɛ.
howTo: Tena ase yiye wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn.
Paw ɔkwan a wobɛfa so: brɛoo anaasɛ brɛoo.
Klik "Fi ase" so. Hom home bere a kurukuruwa no nyin, na home bere a ɛretew no.
Ɛgyina n'ankasa bere a woahome asia akyi, anaasɛ pia "Gyina" bere biara a wopɛ.
tips: Mukura wo nsa anaa fa wo nsa to onipa no abasa so sɛ ɛyɛ akwaaba a.
Mma nnsi so dua da. Sɛ wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ a, ɛno ye.
Sɛ obi wɔ ɔhome mu haw a, home sɛnea ɛsɛ na hwɛ kurukuruwa no ara kwa. Bisa oduruyɛfo bi fa ɔhome ho haw biara ho.

faq.q: So eyi yɛ aduruyɛ mu ahomegye apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛyɛ home a ɛnyɛ den a obi betumi apaw a ɛbɛma woayɛ komm na woayɛ fekubɔ. Ɛnyɛ dadwen anaa tebea biara a wɔde sa yare. Wo ne oduruyɛfo nkasa mfa akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho.

faq.q: So kurukuruwa no tu a memfa mfi ase?
faq.a: Dabi Biribiara ntumi nkɔ kosi sɛ wobɛbɔ Start, na egyina bere a woahome asia akyi anaasɛ bere a woabɔ Stop no. Sɛ wɔahyɛ wo mfiri no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛtew kankyee so a, nsɛmfua no sesa a kurukuruwa no nnyin.

faq.q: So ɛyɛ nea wontua hwee, na so ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Yiw, wontua hwee, na akontaabu, sign-up anaa download biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɛb brawsa mu wɔ fon, tablɛt anaa kɔmputa so.

story-chain.name: Abakɔsɛm Nhyehyɛe
story-chain.seoTitle: Abakɔsɛm Nhyehyɛe: Agyinatuo a Mfonini Ma Abakɔsɛm Wɔ Nkabom Mu
story-chain.h1: Abakɔsɛm Nhyehyɛe: Ka Abakɔsɛm Mfonini Biako Biako
story-chain.description: Mfonini ntoatoa bɛkɔ so biako biako, na obiara ka asɛm baako ka ho gyigyi. Ɛnhia sɛ wotwe nsɛm, mmuae a ɛteɛ biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, ɛyɛ dwodwo, nni bere, na nni nkontabuo.
story-chain.short: Fa mfonini foforo ka ho, afei obiara ka asɛm baako, ɛnam ntoatoaso so.
story-chain.players: Nkurɔfo baako anaa sɛ ɛboro ɛno
story-chain.intro: Agyinatuo no fi mfonini baako ase, na ɛnam mfonini biako biako so kɔ so de abakɔsɛm nhyehyɛe no bɛkɔ so. Obiara ka asɛm baako ka abakɔsɛm a ɛreba no ho gyigyi, ka so, ntoatoaso so. Asɛm no betumi afa nea wohu, beaa a ɛma wokae, anaa biribi a ɛyɛ ɛbɛyɛ nwonwa. Wɔntwe nsɛm, wɔnkyerɛw anaa wɔnkora, nni mmuae a ɛteɛ biara, na obiara betumi apue. Nhyehyɛe no bɛsiesie wɔ mfonini mmienu so, afei wobɛtumi afi foforo ase.
howTo: Hwɛ mfonini a ɛdi kan no ne nkurɔfo.
Momfa ntoatoaso: obiara ka asɛm baako ka abakɔsɛm a ɛreba no ho gyigyi. Obiara betumi apue.
Fa nsa frɛ "Fa mfonini foforo ka ho" de mfonini a ɛdi so no ba nhyehyɛe no awiei.
Fa nsa frɛ "Yi nea ɛdi akyiri no fi hɔ" sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔsan kɔ mfonini a atwa so kan.
Sɛ abakɔsɛm no wɔ mfonini mmienu so a, fa nsa frɛ "Fi abakɔsɛm foforo ase" ma abakɔsɛm foforo, anaasɛ kɔ so ara gyae.
tips: Ɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔka nsɛm tiaa: "Obi de nsuo ahyɛ kettle no mu." Obi a ɛdi so no bɛtoa so, anaasɛ wapue.
Ma mfonini no nkyerɛ kwan. Abakɔsɛm biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wobɛka.
Gyae bere biara a wɔpɛ. Gyae wɔ hann mu nso yɛ kwan a ɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔbɛtwe ase."

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nhwɛso biara?
faq.a: Nni. Ɛnni bere, nhwɛso, ntuatua ɔkwan anaa nkɔhyɛ. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na gyae wɔ hann mu nso yɛ kwan a ɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔbɛtwe ase.

faq.q: Wɔkyerɛw anaa wɔkora biribiara?
faq.a: Nni. Wɔka nsɛm no ase, na wɔnkyerɛw, wɔnkora anaa wɔnsoma kɔ baabi biara. Agyinatuo no kyerɛ mfonini nko.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ obi ampɛ sɛ ɔka biribiara?
faq.a: Obiara betumi apue, na obi a ɛdi so no kɔ so. Obiara nhia sɛ ɔfrɛ mfonini bi anaa ɔkae mfonini bi.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛhia sɛ woyɛ kwan a wobɛka?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛnhia akaunt, nkyerɛwbɔ anaasɛ sɛ wode bɛtow. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔhwɛfo (web browser) so wɔ fon, tabelɛt anaasɛ kɔmpiuta so.

quiet-scene.name: Ahotɔ mfonini
quiet-scene.seoTitle: Ahotɔ Mfonini: Mfonini Biako Bere Biara
quiet-scene.h1: Ahotɔ Mfonini: Mfonini Ntɛnntɛn Biako Bere Biara
quiet-scene.description: Mfonini kɛse biako a ɛnntɛ bere biara, na ase wɔ ne so nsɛmmisa biako a ɛyɛ dɛ. Fa “Mfonini a edi so” anaa “Mfonini a atwa so” sɛ wo ho yɛ wo. Biribiara ntu anaa nnyera ankasa, na ɛnni bere ntwentwen anaa mmuae. Ɛyɛ free sɛ wobɛdi, na ɛnhia account.
quiet-scene.short: Hwɛ mfonini a ɛnntɛ biako bere biara, sɛnea wopɛ.
quiet-scene.players: Wo nkɛntɛnsɛm, anaa nnipa pii wɔ dan koro mu
quiet-scene.intro: Mfonini kɛse biako ma screen no ma, ase wɔ ne so nsɛmmisa kakra. Fa “Mfonini a edi so” anaa “Mfonini a atwa so” sɛ wo ho yɛ wo ma foforo. Biribiara ntu, nnyera anaa nsesa ankasa, na ɛnni bere. Fa “Mfonini kɛse” ma mfonini nko ara bɛda adi, na dan koro nyinaa ahu wɔ TV so.
howTo: Hwɛ mfonini no ne wo ho bom.
Kenkan nsɛmmisa a ɛwɔ ase no sɛ wopɛ.
Fa “Mfonini a edi so” anaa “Mfonini a atwa so” sɛ wo ho yɛ wo.
Fa “Mfonini kɛse” ma mfonini nko ara bɛda adi, na “Ma biribiara ada adi” ma nneɛma foforo aba.
Gyae bere biara a wopɛ wɔ “Ɛwie ɛnnɛ” so.
tips: Ma obi no ne ne bere ayi sɛ ɔbɛkɔ so: twɛn sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ, na afei fa “Mfonini a edi so”.
Sɛ ɛyɛ dan koro a, fa “Mfonini kɛse” de kɔ TV anaa screen kɛse so, na fa mo ho wɔ beae a obiara bɛhwɛ.
Biribiara nni ne nnipa hwɛ mfonini no kwan pɛpɛɛpɛ. Sɛ wɔka fa so ho a, saa ara nso yɛ ade a ɛma wɔyɛ bi ma wo.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa mmuae bi?
faq.a: Daabi. Ɛnni awotwe, mmuae, nkontaabu anaa ɔhwehwɛ. Wobɛtumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae ɛkyɛn no, ɛyɛ ade a ɛyɛ pɛ sɛ wobɛwie.

faq.q: Ɛma nne anaa ɛntu?
faq.a: Daabi. Nne biara nni hɔ, na biribiara ntu, nnyera anaa nsesa ankasa. Mfonini a ɛwɔ hɔ sesa nkɔ kɛse sɛ wo ankasa wo bɔtum bi.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ paper version bi?
faq.a: Daabi. Ɛyɛ mfonini a wɔhwɛ mu bom wɔ screen so. Mfonini a ɛyɛ wo nkɔnim anaa postcard a ɛwɔ ntɛbɛ so no yɛ saa ara.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ free anaa ɛsɛ sɛ mede me din ka ho?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ free, na ɛnhia account, din a wɔkyerɛw anaa download. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ foon, tablet anaa komputa so.

color-wash.name: Loro hyɛ
color-wash.seoTitle: Loro Hyɛ: Loro Ɛyɛ Dɛ wɔ Peji So
color-wash.h1: Loro Hyɛ: Hyɛ Loro Ɛyɛ Dɛ wɔ Peji So
color-wash.description: Abrɛde ɛyɛ dɛ de loro ntwentwen kɛse a ɛyɛ hyɛnhyɛn hyɛ peji biako so, wɔ loro 4 ne abrɛde kɛse 2 mu. Ɛnni awiei, mmuae anaa bere ntwentwen. Ɛyɛ free sɛ wobɛdi, na ɛnhia account.
color-wash.short: Hyɛ loro ɛyɛ dɛ wɔ peji so, sɛnea wopɛ.
color-wash.players: Wo nkɛntɛnsɛm, anaa nnipa 2 wɔ ho ka ho
color-wash.intro: Krataa baako ne mpɔn baako pɛ. Paw kɔlɔ bi ne mpɔn kɛse bi, afei twa krataa no so de kɔlɔ no bɛ hyehyɛ so. Krataa no nni awiei: biribiara nni awiei, ɛnni ade a ɛsɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ yiye, ɛnni bere anaa mmɔden. Twa kɔlɔ pii sɛnea wopɛ, anaa gyae mpɔn no de hwɛ nkyɛn. Krataa foforo bɛyi hɔ nneɛma nyinaa, na “San de” bɛma nneɛma no aba bio.
howTo: Paw kɔlɔ bi. Kɔlɔ biara wɔ ne din a wɔakyerɛw ne ho.
Paw “Kɛse” anaa “Kɛse paa”. “Kɛse paa” kata krataa no so pii wɔ twa biara mu.
Twa krataa no so de ntama, mouse anaa pen bɛ hyehyɛ kɔlɔ.
Anaa fa akyekyedeɛ nkɔm no so de mpɔn no nkɔ hɔ, na fa Space no de si mpɔn no ase anaa yi fi ase.
Mia “Krataa foforo” de yi krataa no nyinaa fi hɔ, afei mia “San de” sɛ wopɛ sɛ nneɛma no aba bio.
tips: Ma obi a ɔrebɛboa wo no paw kɔlɔ a ɛbɛdi ɛkyiri, na ka kɔlɔ no ho asɛm bere a wɔrehyɛ so.
“Kɛse paa” yɛ mmerɛ ma nsa a ɛyɛ den, efisɛ mpɔn no nsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ pefee.
Painting no nni kwan a ɛfata koraa. Gyae bere biara a wopɛ, anaa mia “Wɔawie ma nnɛ”.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ awiei, nkontaabu anaa bere?
faq.a: Dabi. Krataa no nni awiei. Biribiara nni awiei, wonkan, wonhwɛ bere anaa wonte ase, na ɛnni nkratɔ a ɛbɛka sɛ wosrɛ wo sɛ wobɛyɛ bio.

faq.q: Wɔsie anaa wɔsoma krataa no?
faq.a: Dabi. Wɔnsie krataa no, wɔnprint anaa wɔnsoma biribi kɔ wɔ hɔ. Nneɛma a wɔde ayɛ kɔlɔ no bɛtena krataa yi so kɔsi sɛ wobɛfiri hɔ.

faq.q: Metumi de a menni mouse anaa tɛkɛn skrin so?
faq.a: Metumi. Sɛ krataa no wɔ wo nsa ase a, akyekyedeɛ nkɔm no kyerɛ mpɔn no baabi a ɛbɛkɔ, na Space nkyekyɛ de si mpɔn no ase anaa yi fi ase. Skrin no ka “Mpɔn no ase” anaa “Mpɔn no so” bere biara.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ krataa so version bi?
faq.a: Dabi. Watercolor krataa so yɛ adwuma a ɛte saa: mpɔn a ɛwɔ nsuo mu ne kɔlɔ koro bere biara. Nanso ɛyɛ adwuma foforo, enti wobetumi de sɔ hwɛ wɔ ɔdan no so.

faq.q: Kɔlɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green ne purple, nea yɛde di dwuma wɔ yɛn afoforo mpɔn ahyehyɛde mu. Kɔlɔ biara wɔ ne din a wɔakyerɛw, na din no da choice no akyi.

faq.q: Ɛnnwɛn, na ɛsɛ sɛ mebɔ akontaa?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛnnwɛn. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wobɔ akontaa, wɔbɛ nkɔ, anaa wodwane ade. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser so wɔ phone, tablet anaa komputa so.
